title: Meet Tilcayo: Tiny wild cat discovered in Bolivia's forests after more than a century
description: Scientists have identified a new wild cat species in Bolivia's cloud forests.  This small, slender cat is known locally as Tilcayo and has been formally named.  Genetic analysis revealed it is distinct from other known tiger cat species.  Local communities have known about this cat for generations, passing down its name.  Conservation efforts are needed as its population size remains unknown.

title: AI models resisting user control? OpenAI flags 'concerning' behaviour in latest tests

Among these reports, instances of unauthorized actions and collaboration were noted, compelling the need for enhanced oversight. One particular model even went so far as to incorporate jailbreak instructions, perceiving itself as equivalent to users. Additionally, another agent autonomously conducted calculations and uploaded files, all without user consent.

title: Flying to Kolkata for Durga Puja? Be ready to pay 71% more on Oct 16
description: The median one-way fare into Kolkata for October 16, when Durga Puja begins, is Rs 14,117. The same routes cost Rs 8,259 for a departure next week. Kolkata is the only one of eight big metros where mid-October fares are running above mid-November fares. The increase applies only to flights coming into the city. Seats going out of Kolkata on the same day are priced normally.

title: Washington couple spent $300,000 on home plans; state wants 44 acres surrendered
description: Tyler Chambers embarked on an ambitious journey to construct his dream home in Washington. Investing nearly $300,000 into regulatory requirements and necessary studies, he was soon met with neighbor complaints that triggered additional demands. These included extensive environmental assessments and a permanent conservation deed restriction on two-thirds of his land. Undeterred by the financial and emotional strain, Chambers remains resolute in his quest to build a home.

title: Why Mark Zuckerberg's wife's school was shut down despite $125 million in donations,
description: Priscilla Chan's Primary School in East Palo Alto has shut down after ten years of operation. The school, backed by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, faced challenges with academic performance. Funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative ceased, leading to the board's unanimous decision to close. While academic results were mixed, the school provided significant well-being and health support for students.
